title: Snapshot Array
description: Implement a SnapshotArray that supports setting values at indices and taking snapshots to retrieve values at specific versions.
pseudocode:
1: snapshots = [[]]
2: snap_id = 0
3: def set(index, val):
4:   snapshots[snap_id][index] = val
5: def snap():
6:   snap_id++
7:   snapshots[snap_id] = snapshots[snap_id-1].slice()
8: def get(index, id):
9:   return snapshots[id][index]

steps.note: Initialize snapshots array with an empty state for version 0.
Setting index 0 to value 5 at snap_id 0.
Taking a snapshot, incrementing snap_id to 1.
Copying state from version 0 to version 1.
Setting index 0 to value 10 at snap_id 1.
Retrieving value at index 0, version 0: returns 5.
